summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Japanese Property Tokenization Platform. Backend APIs are 81% functional with all critical endpoints working. Frontend loads properly but has Mixed Content issue preventing property detail page from loading.

security_issues.impact: Admin functions accessible without proper authorization

integration_issues.issue: API calls fail due to Mixed Content Policy
